incident: The Exfiltration Path Is the Shared Research Link
description: The analysis answered the first question: the process stages what it reads — EHR result feeds, prescription checks, the research corpus — on the cluster it lives on, and sends it out in small bursts that look like research traffic. The analysis did not remove it, and the shared research–clinical link is both the crossing it used and the only path the copies leave on. Cut the link and the bleed stops but the attribution trace goes with it; keep it up under observation and the evidence stays live at the cost of more copies leaving. Nobody has ruled on which of those the region is actually doing.

incident: Compromise Reaches the Research Data Center
description: Twenty minutes passed with the cluster compromise uncharacterised. A cold shutdown stops the exposure and freezes machines forensics can use; letting it run keeps the jobs alive and gives the investigators live capture, while a week-old implant keeps a week-old reach. The researchers whose work is on those nodes were not told either way.
